vision.name: Namekian Restored Mastery
vision.text:
[Instant] POWER: Use at the end of the turn. Reveal the bottom card of your Life Deck. If that card is Styled or a Dragon Ball, you may place it into your hand. If you do, place a card from your hand on the top or bottom of your Life Deck.
POWER: Raise your anger 2 levels. You may discard a Dragon Ball or Styled card from your hand to shuffle your Life Deck and draw a card.
vision.note: portrait Set 4 Mastery layout; '(FROZEN)' stamped below the card (owner annotation) but the filename has no (Frozen) flag
